entry.hypothesis: H4 - weighting every ETF inverse to its volatility (fully invested, no filter) earns a higher Sharpe than equal weight; expected to LOSE to 60/40 on return (control that isolates the trend filter in H1).
entry.rationale: Leverage aversion (Asness-Frazzini-Pedersen 2012) - low-risk assets offer higher risk-adjusted returns and balancing risk diversifies better than balancing capital; without leverage the book is bond-heavy, so gate (b) is expected to fail.
